'''Brevis Taug''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived during the [[Rise of the Empire era]].

==Biography==
Taug was a rich shipping magnate and he secretly funded the construction of a new fleet of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] for the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]], in return for a cut of their profits. At the start of each month, Taug would transfer funds to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled company on [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]], which would then be passed on to the Zygerrians. A year after making the deal, he was arrested by intelligence officers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as part of a long-running sting, and charged with fraud. In an attempt to reduced his sentence, he told his captors about the deal he had made with the Zygerrians.
